why_trail.why: Handoff complete on all seven fields; seam premise reproduced at source; the two shipped modules read end to end.

Adversarial fixture found a REAL defect the handoff did not predict: durable_root() returns its start argument UNCHANGED on every fallback path, so handing it the spine directory (not the repo root) double-nests LESSONS.md. Fixed by resolving durable from repo_root().

emit_step_manifest builds via build_manifest, writes via manifest_path/write_manifest, and returns early when the destination exists so the snapshot is never rewritten. base_dir=None writes nothing, which keeps in-process engine calls from scattering manifests.
